meta.name: Online Learning Platform
meta.description: An online learning platform where instructors publish courses and students enroll, complete lessons, and provide reviews, with a freemium model offering access to paid courses and certificates via subscription.

roles.name: instructor
roles.description: Can publish courses and view student progress.

roles.name: student
roles.description: Can enroll in courses, mark lessons complete, rate and review.

assumptions: There will be an admin role to manage the platform.
Users will have profiles to store their information.
Completion certificates are generated automatically upon course completion for subscribed users.
